task:
Create one figure containing an image followed by its visible caption.

The img must use src="moon.jpg", alt="Crescent Moon above a dark horizon", width="640" and height="480". Follow it with a figcaption whose text is `Moonrise at dusk`. The caption supplements the alternative text; keep both. Do not add other figures or images. The exercise inspects markup without fetching the image.

Use only HTML in this file; no JavaScript or CSS is needed. Keep the specified text, element order and attributes. Checks inspect the parsed DOM; whitespace and attribute order do not matter.

## Examples

Input: `["figure img", "alt"]` → output: `["Crescent Moon above a dark horizon"]`.
Input: `["figure figcaption", "text"]` → output: `["Moonrise at dusk"]`.

expected: Crescent Moon above a dark horizon
